elements.text: Copy Publish Top Three New Consumer AI Assistant Features — April 2026 April 2026 brought a tightly clustered wave of consumer-facing upgrades from the three leading assistants. The three most significant launches were OpenAI's revamped image generator, Anthropic's first dedicated visual-design product, and Google's monthly Gemini Drop featuring a new Notebooks workspace and native Mac app. 1. ChatGPT Images 2.0 (OpenAI) — Announced April 21, 2026 OpenAI rolled out a new image-generation model ("gpt-image-2") in ChatGPT that plans layout before rendering and—for the first time—produces clean, readable text in scripts including Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Hindi, and Bengali. Two modes shipped: an Instant mode free to all users and a Thinking mode for paid subscribers that refines images before output. The release positions ChatGPT image generation as a viable tool for marketing mockups, infographics, and educational materials rather than novelty art. Source: https://medium.com/no-time/chatgpt-images-2-0-just-dropped-and-its-seriously-good-38f31becd626 Medium Medium 2. Claude Design (Anthropic) — Launched April 17, 2026 Anthropic introduced Claude Design, an experimental product that lets users generate prototypes, slides, one-pagers, and UI mockups from natural-language prompts, then refine them with direct edits. Powered by Claude Opus 4.7, it can ingest a company's codebase and design files to apply existing design systems. It is available in research preview to Claude Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise subscribers, targeting founders and product managers without design backgrounds. Source: https://techcrunch.com/2026/04/17/anthropic-launches-claude-design-a-new-product-for-creating-quick-visuals/ TechCrunch 3. Gemini April Drop — Notebooks, Native Mac App, Personal Intelligence (Google) Google's 10th Gemini Drop delivered three notable consumer additions: Notebooks (NotebookLM-style project workspaces inside the Gemini app, syncing chats, PDFs, and sources); a native macOS Gemini app; and the global expansion of Personal Intelligence, which connects Gmail, Drive, Photos, and Calendar for personalized assistance. The Drop also added Lyria 3 Pro music generation (up to 3-minute tracks, free). Source: https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/products/gemini-app/gemini-drop-april-2026/ iPhone in Canada + 2
